units.source_text: 可以断言，鹤川所居住的世界即使洋溢着明朗的感情和善意，但他也并不是仰仗误解和乐观的判断而居住在那里的。

en.t: It can be said with certainty that even though the world Tsurukawa inhabited overflowed with bright feelings and goodwill, he did not live there by relying on misunderstanding or optimistic judgment.

units.source_text: 他那颗在这个世界难以实现的光明磊落的心，是以一种力量，一种坚韧的柔软性来保证的，这就成为他的运动的法则。

en.t: His open and radiant heart, so difficult to realize in this world, was sustained by a kind of strength, a tenacious flexibility, and this became the law of his movement.

units.source_text: 他把我明暗的感情-一译成明朗的感情，这种做法含有某种无比正确的东西。

en.t: He translated my mixed feelings of light and darkness into bright feelings, and in that act there was something incomparably right.

units.source_text: 这种光明，同我的阴暗在每一角落里都过分地照应，过分地显示出详细的对比，所以有时我不免怀疑起使川是否如实地产生过我这样的心位来了。

en.t: This brightness corresponded too closely with my darkness in every corner and displayed the detailed contrast too plainly, so at times I could not help wondering whether Tsurukawa had ever truly produced a state of mind like mine.
In fact, that was not the case at all!

units.source_text: 他的世界的光明是纯粹的，也是偏颇的，它建立其自身的细致的体系，它的精密程度也许接近于丑恶的精密程度。

en.t: The brightness of his world was pure, and also biased; it built its own delicate system, and its precision may have come close to the precision of ugliness.

units.source_text: 倘使这个青年人不屈不挠的肉体力量不是在不断地支撑着它而运动的话，也许这个光明的透明的世界就会突然瓦解。

en.t: If the indomitable physical strength of this young man had not constantly supported it and kept it in motion, perhaps this bright, transparent world would have suddenly collapsed.
He ran straight ahead with fearless determination.

units.source_text: 于是卡车辗轧了他的肉体。

en.t: Then the truck crushed his body beneath its wheels.
